_about: 4-29 (R1 fix 2): antiportal_1995 (576, 24), scale 5, refuses within 160 px at 32 x scale, which
holds button_2037, door_lift_2038, the keyhole's cell and the door; the knights' corridor below (y
208, 184 px or more from the centre) is free. A shot lights the torch (40) and the light wall goes
(130). A portal at (400, 60) over the upper platform (180 px from the ring's centre), from the start
ledge; right off the ledge into the corridor, where knight B pushes the player right under the upper
platform; a portal at (640, 205) in knight A's path (192 px) while it walks right toward wayA1: it
walks in with the key (866) and drops onto the upper platform, walks right toward its waypoint's x,
presses button_2037 in passing and waits against door_lift_2038. Left behind knight B to x 337; a
portal at (400, 80) (185 px) and one at (365, 204) that the player walks into: up onto the upper
platform, right onto button_2037 behind the knight. The lift rises, the knight goes under it, its
key opens keyhole_ent_1943 and door_locked_ent_1939 goes; the player stays on the button until the
lift is well up (1435), then right under it and behind the knight into the door. Since step 133 the
knight's press in passing (1066) latches the lift door all the way up (8000 ms, eased, 102.4 u) as
the original's does, so the knight goes under it sooner: the keyhole on 1217 (1353 before) and the
yellow door on 1265 (1401). Won on tick 1501 (1519 before). Leans on G1 (the knights never see or
shoot), the port's patrol (a knight lifted off its floor never comes within 8 px of its waypoint and
walks on toward that waypoint's x), the port's traversal by body overlap (the knight walks into a
portal whose centre is at the knight's head), G10 and G4 (shot speed).
